# omada_site (Data Source)

Looks up an Omada site by name or ID. With no selector, returns the provider's configured site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_site" "current" {}

output "site_id" {
  value = data.omada_site.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Site ID lookup selector and result.
- `name` (String) Site name lookup selector and result.
